text:
sylvie: Quick sync — we need to lock the plan for integrating FlashAttention v2/v3 into the chooser. Found a perf divergence on long-chat profiles this morning.
ashok: Seen the profiling dump, looks like v3 wins on 1k+ tokens but regresses at 256-512 in some kernels.
maria: Can you paste the profile? small samples matter for our PLG tail latency.
ashvie: attaching short snippet from profiler: 
```
profile: model=x-large, batch=8
flashv2: p50=9.4ms p95=24.3ms p99=58.2ms throughput=210req/s GPU=40%
flashv3: p50=8.9ms p95=26.7ms p99=120.4ms throughput=195req/s GPU=55%
fallback(fused): p50=10.2ms p95=30.1ms p99=70.1ms throughput=200req/s GPU=48%
kv-ops: v3 shows more KV-miss eviction churn for seq<512
```
ashok: that p99 spike with v3 looks like a kernel slow-path on short sequences + KV cache thrash. We should not flip the global selector to v3 by default.
maria: Agreed. Proposal: update chooser heuristics to prefer fused-attn for seq<=512 and batch<=16, prefer flashv3 for seq>=1024 or if kv-hot-hit rate>90%. Otherwise v2 as a middle ground.
kevin: +1. Also add a runtime flag to force v2/v3 per-route for debugging: ff.attn_selector.override = [none | force_v2 | force_v3 | force_fused].
sylvie: Ops rollout plan: staged rollout across infra: 1) canary pool (5 hosts, 0.5% traffic) with ff.attn_selector=force_v3 + kv-cache-metrics on; 2) expand to canary2 (10 hosts, 2% traffic) with chooser heuristics live; 3) ramp to 20% with automatic rollback triggers.
ashok: Define rollback triggers: p99_latency > baseline_p99 * 1.5 for more than 10min OR error_rate > 0.5% OR gpu_util > baseline+25% for 15min.
maria: Add functional smoke: run prompt-set 'regress-short-seqs' and 'interactive-chat' on each canary after deploy. Pass == 0 functional diffs.
kevin: I'll add fflags + rollout job in CI. Also add a metric: kv_eviction_rate and kv_miss_ratio per model shard.
infra-bot: deploy started: stack=eng-runtime/canary-1 flashattn=v3 image=sha256:abc123
sylvie: Note on batching heuristics — we saw larger batches amplify v3 GPU throughput but worsen small-request p99. Suggest adaptive batching: limit batch size to 12 for seq<=512 and allow 32+ for seq>=1024.
ashok: Implementation note: chooser needs sequence_length_estimate, route-level override, and an observed_kv_hot_hit window (sliding 5min). That should be cheap to compute in the routing layer.
maria: Also watch cost signal — v3 uses more GPU cycles for small seqs (higher cost/token). Add cost-per-token metric for A/B.
kevin: Timeline: implement heuristics + fflag this week, run internal perf harness Friday, canary Monday.
sylvie: One more: fallback policy if v3 fails mid-request — immediate fallback to fused-attn (not v2) to preserve latency for small seqs. We'll keep v2 as conservative baseline for throughput heavy workloads.
maria: noted. I'll own the regression dashboard and the smoke prompt sets.
ashok: I'll add low-level kernel telemetry (kernel-id, runtime-ms) to profiling to isolate which op regresses.
kevin: adding rollout docs and rollback playbook in the canary runbook.
sylvie: Perfect. If any of you spot p99 > baseline during canary, @ashok and @maria ping immediately. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy succeeded on canary-1 (5 hosts) in 00:04:32
kevin: running smoke now...
maria: smoke passed for 'interactive-chat'. 'regress-short-seqs' shows a slight p95 bump (12%); not hitting rollback thresholds.
sylvie: OK proceed to canary2 tomorrow. Keep an eye on kv_eviction_rate.
ashok: FYI I opened a small perf issue: PERF-1429 — possible micro-optimizer in v3 kernel for small heads. Assigning to eng-runtime/attn-kernel.
maria: closing loop: feature flags we'll use: ff.attn_selector.mode, ff.attn_selector.force, ff.attn_selector.kv_threshold. I'll add entries to the feature flags registry.
sylvie: Thanks all — this thread is the live log. We'll update with metrics during the ramp.
